# 📝 Pull Request

## Description
Briefly describe the changes you're making and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (fixing incorrect information)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (new guide or section)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation improvement (clarification, examples, etc.)
- [ ] 🎨 Content enhancement (diagrams, formatting, etc.)
- [ ] 🔄 Refactoring (reorganizing content)

## Related Issue
Links to related issues (if applicable):
- Closes #123
- Related to #456

## Changes Made
Describe the specific changes:
- [ ] Changed/added/removed content in: [which guide(s)]
- [ ] Updated: [what specifically]
- [ ] Added: [diagrams, examples, sections]

## Checklist
- [ ] Content is accurate and well-researched
- [ ] Examples are clear and run-able (if applicable)
- [ ] Spelling and grammar are correct
- [ ] Follows the repository's style guide
- [ ] Diagrams (Mermaid) are correctly formatted
- [ ] No duplicate content with existing guides
- [ ] Tested against actual Git/GitHub behavior (if applicable)

## Screenshots/Examples
If adding diagrams or significant changes, please include:
- Before/after comparisons
- New diagram previews
- Output examples

## Reviewer Notes
Any additional information for reviewers:
- Is this a significant content change?
- Does this conflict with existing content?
- Skill level of content: (beginner/intermediate/advanced)

## Motivation and Context
Why is this change important?
- Solves a learning gap?
- Updates outdated information?
- Makes content clearer?

---

**Thank you for contributing to my-git-learnings!** 🙌
